content_html: Thanks, this is great stuff. I am really looking forward to seeing you down in Austin to discuss this stuff in detail!

Estimating is always hard. I can say that my estimation skills since I started using stories, story points and small digestable tasks have gotten much better. My groups in the past have doing very close to 100% normal scrum – 1 month iterations, daily meetings, etc. That being said – the group I am with now – the shortest possible iterations – more like ~1-2 weeks seem better. Time boxing is key/ hard. My point is that I think that there is no globally ideal iteration length. It depends (IMHO) on the team and the organization that you are working in.

-Chris
